limitations: Post-review development exclusions, not calibrated classifiers or accepted error bounds. Low detector scores can remove valid English/slang/code; high scores do not prove understanding. Scope expressions quarantine some benign educational or historical text and miss other mature/sensitive content. Unverified code, source identity/role artifacts and unfilled templates are deferred. Any attended or reviewed-excluded/unresolved member quarantines the complete existing group. Unsampled factual errors, private details and bias can remain. A new prospective group sample and a separately bound delegated research decision are required before any admission; no production/SFW/privacy/factual certification or new training authorization.
scope: Measure a proposed local language-foundation research pool. Not a release or conversation-SFT gold corpus.
